description:
Greenfield Go scenario at scenarios/vrooli-events/. Core runtime with:

**Event store** — SQLite with WAL mode (pragmas: journal_mode=WAL, busy_timeout=10000, synchronous=NORMAL). Schema: events table with id (INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, doubles as SSE Last-Event-ID), event_id (TEXT UNIQUE), source_scenario, target_scenario, event_type, correlation_id, payload (BLOB, proto-serialized Any), metadata (TEXT, JSON map), created_at. Indexes on event_type, source_scenario, correlation_id (partial WHERE != ''), created_at.

**Dual-trigger pruning** — Background goroutine every 6 hours: DELETE WHERE created_at < 30 days OR size > 2GB (oldest first). No VACUUM in hot path.

**SSE pub/sub server** — 30-second heartbeat (': heartbeat\n\n' comment line), retry: 5000ms, Last-Event-ID resume from event store autoincrement id. Non-blocking send with 64-capacity subscriber channels; drop+notify backpressure (dropped_count in next heartbeat). Standard SSE format: id: (sequence), event: (type for client filtering), data: (JSON envelope).

**Event ingestion** — Async non-blocking endpoint. Structured event IDs ({scenario}.{domain}.{action}.{version}) with glob-pattern subscription matching.

**CLI** — Event queries, subscription management. Storage: SQLite + file-based. No Postgres, no Redis.

Note: Policy CRUD API and enforcement middleware are in separate item execute/vrooli-events-policy-api-and-middleware.

title: Build The vrooli-events Scenario Core Runtime
